mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, price, quantity, amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{dishId}, #{dishName}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT oi.dish_id, oi.dish_name, oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.amount FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
